participants.label: Support agent
participants.note: guest on the internal conversation: may post guest messages only and cannot read it. reply_mode auto: replies to the user while no person picked up the ticket. Stops after 10 agent turns per ticket and waits for a person. File-system isolation comes later

participants.label: Guest message queue
participants.note: every guest message and file waits here until screened; the internal conversation holds a reference with a shield: green passed, red held

participants.label: Internal agent
participants.sublabel: runs the RCA, admin on the support agent
participants.note: sees only screened messages, never the ticket or its files; never talks to the user; writes freely in the internal conversation

participants.label: Team
participants.note: sees the RCA report, steer messages and the shield on every guest message; can @tag the internal agent

messages.label: opens a request
messages.note: a help desk ticket; the ticket gets its own agent process, matched by conversation id

messages.label: Thank you, we are on it
messages.note: sent at once: reply_mode auto and the agent is alone in the ticket

messages.label: guest message: the request and its files
messages.note: the only action the guest role allows; diagnosis files from the user's machine are screened like text

messages.label: screening
messages.note: Google Model Armor; the message waits in the queue, unreadable by conversation members

messages.label: shield on the message: green or red
messages.note: the internal conversation holds a reference to the queued message with its screening status

messages.label: release or reject a held message
messages.note: only when the screening flagged it: a red message waits for a person

messages.label: passed message
messages.note: the internal agent is exposed only to the screened message

messages.label: /rca
messages.note: one RCA run per iteration

messages.label: need more info from the user?
messages.note: the one question after each RCA run. Yes: m10 to m16. No (RCA is clear): go to m18

messages.label: steer: info request
messages.note: POST agent/<id>/steer/conversation/<ticket id>, allowed for admin. Posted in the internal conversation and delivered from there into the ticket's process; starts the process when none runs

messages.label: status only: delivered, ran, failed
messages.note: no text comes back this way; anything the support agent says to the internal side is a guest message

messages.label: asks the user for the info
messages.note: the wording is the support agent's; assume the user can see whatever a steer message says

messages.label: guest message: the user's reply
messages.note: screened as in m4 to m6

messages.label: /rca again, until clear
messages.note: repeat m8 to m15 until the RCA is clear; the unattended loop stops after 10 agent turns per ticket

messages.label: RCA report
messages.note: free text in the internal conversation once the RCA is clear

messages.label: @agent: more details?
messages.note: optional: the team tags the agent in the conversation itself

messages.label: steer: response for the user
messages.note: same steer action; logged in the internal conversation with its delivery status

messages.label: user's reaction
messages.note: the support agent keeps watching the ticket after the response

messages.label: a person picks up the ticket
messages.note: optional, at any point: in reply_mode auto the agent stops replying to the user, and a steer message from the internal agent no longer produces a reply

messages.label: guest message: ticket closed
messages.note: screened like any other; the internal side closes the internal conversation
